title: Microsoft Entra ID: extended 30-day backup and recovery through Microsoft 365 Backup
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned 30-day extension from existing Entra recovery and substantiates its listed admin paths, API calls and pricing context. Minor corrections should acknowledge the documented billing migration option and identify checklist controls missing from the table.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans extended Entra object backup and recovery through Microsoft 365 Backup.
claims.quote: Enable extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs.

claims.claim: The planned extension offers point-in-time recovery to a last known good state within a rolling 30-day history.
claims.quote: This capability allows customers and ISV apps to do a point in time restore of Entra objects to a last known good state to a rolling historical 30-day point.

claims.claim: Customers would use the Microsoft 365 Backup native app in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: some user recovery actions will be possible via the M365 Backup native app UX in the M365 Admin center.
